  • Method Details

    • saveRecipe

      public void saveRecipe(String recipeId)
      Approves a pending recipe, changing its status from "PENDING" to "APPROVED". The recipe is removed from the admin's list of pending recipes and the corresponding chef's list, and is then added to the new recipes list. Finally, it is asynchronously added to the graph database.
      Parameters:
      recipeId - the unique identifier of the recipe to be approved
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if the admin or the recipe is not found in the database, or if the recipe is not in a "PENDING" state

    • discardRecipe

      public void discardRecipe(String recipeId)
      Rejects a pending recipe, removing it from both the admin's approval list and the corresponding chef's waiting list. The recipe is then permanently deleted from the database.
      Parameters:
      recipeId - the unique identifier of the recipe to discard
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if the admin or the recipe is not found, or if the recipe is already approved

    • approveChef

      public void approveChef(String chefUsername)
      Approves a pending chef registration request. The chef is removed from the admin's pending list, its status is changed to "APPROVED", and the corresponding node is added to the graph database.
      Parameters:
      chefUsername - the unique username of the chef to approve
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if the admin or the chef is not found, or if the chef's status is already "APPROVED"

    • declineChef

      public void declineChef(String chefUsername)
      Rejects a pending chef registration request. The chef is removed from the admin's pending list and from the chef collection.
      Parameters:
      chefUsername - the unique username of the chef to reject
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if the admin or the chef is not found, or if the chef's status is already "APPROVED"

    • showPendingRecipes

      public SliceRecipeDTO<PendingRecipeDTO> showPendingRecipes(int pageNumber)
      Retrieves a paginated list of pending recipes waiting for the admin's approval.
      Parameters:
      pageNumber - the requested page number
      Returns:
      a SliceRecipeDTO containing the requested page of PendingRecipeDTOs, along with two boolean values indicating the existence of previous or next pages
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if the admin is not found
      IllegalArgumentException - if the pageNumber is negative

    • showPendingChefs

      public SliceRecipeDTO<PendingChefDTO> showPendingChefs(int pageNumber)
      Retrieves a paginated list of pending chef request waiting for the admin's approval.
      Parameters:
      pageNumber - the requested page number
      Returns:
      a SliceRecipeDTO containing the requested page of PendingChefDTOs, along with two boolean values indicating the existence of previous or next pages
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if the admin is not found
      IllegalArgumentException - if the pageNumber is negative

    • seeChefDetails

      public RegisteredUserInfoDTO seeChefDetails(String chefUsername)
      Retrieves the detailed information of a chef waiting for the admin approval.
      Parameters:
      chefUsername - unique username of the chef to visualize
      Returns:
      a RegisteredUserInfoDTO containing the detailed profile information of the requested chef
      Throws:

      Throws:

    • getMonthlyFoodies

      public List<YearAnalyticsDTO> getMonthlyFoodies()
      Retrieves registration statistics for foodies. The data is grouped by year and includes a breakdown of new registrations per month.
      Returns:
      a list of YearAnalyticsDTO containing the registration counts grouped by year and month

    • getCategoryTrends

      public List<TrendAnalyticsDTO> getCategoryTrends()
      Analyzes and retrieves the trends of recipe categories based on their creation dates. Compares the volume of recipes created in the last year against the previous year to calculate a percentage growth rate. Classifies each category's trend as "NEW", "EMERGING", "DECLINING", or "STABLE".
      Returns:
      a list of TrendAnalyticsDTO containing the classified trends and growth percentages

    • getBayesianRanking

      public List<ChefRankAnalyticsDTO> getBayesianRanking()
      Calculates and retrieves the ranking of chefs using a Bayesian average scoring system.
      Returns:
      a list of ChefRankAnalyticsDTO containing the ranked chefs, their scores, and their positions
